title: Upgrade an entire work item with task-local reference migration
objective: Extend sdlc ref migrate-task-local-up with --work-item <work-item-id> so one complete work-item directory can be upgraded safely and deterministically, then deliver the change as version 0.4.0 tagged on master.

branch.name: main
branch.rationale: The repository currently uses main; the requested release tag must point to a local master branch at the final release commit.

request.text: Prepare a new .docs/work-items/* to upgrade an entire work item via sdlc ref migrate-task-local-up --work-item <work-item-id>. Commit the work item. Process the work item and minor version bump upon completion. Git tag the new version on master.

scope.name: work-item-migration-option
scope.description: Add --work-item <work-item-id> to migrate the selected .docs/work-items/<id>/ directory, including work-item.json and all task files, without requiring --path.
scope.reason: Callers need one bounded command to upgrade a complete work item rather than manually selecting its files.

scope.name: scope-and-safety-contract
scope.description: Make --work-item and --path mutually exclusive, preserve path containment and unrelated identifiers, and report all changed files and replacements deterministically.
scope.reason: Whole-work-item migration must remain auditable and must not modify neighboring work items or arbitrary repository content.

scope.name: minor-release-and-tag
scope.description: Bump the minor version from 0.3.0 to 0.4.0, verify the compiled CLI, and create annotated tag 0.4.0 on master at the release commit.
scope.reason: The user explicitly requests processing, a minor version bump, and tagging the new version on master.

scope.name: per-task-test-gates
scope.description: Require a complete passing unit-test gate before every implementation, validation, and delivery task commit.
scope.reason: The CLI scope change, persisted work-item migration, and release/tag boundary must remain continuously validated.

nonGoals.name: remote-repository-migration
nonGoals.description: Do not contact remote repositories or migrate work items outside the selected local repository.
nonGoals.reason: The command remains local and deterministic.

nonGoals.name: path-and-work-item-combination
nonGoals.description: Do not accept --path and --work-item together in one migration invocation.
nonGoals.reason: Two independent scopes would make authorization and reporting ambiguous.

nonGoals.name: remote-publication
nonGoals.description: Do not publish or deploy the package; only create the requested local Git tag.
nonGoals.reason: The requested release boundary is a local versioned commit and tag.

items.name: whole-work-item-option
items.description: sdlc ref migrate-task-local-up --work-item <work-item-id> must migrate only the selected work-item directory, including work-item.json and all supported files below its stepsPath.
items.reason: A work-item identifier should be sufficient to select the complete bounded migration scope.

acceptanceCriteria.description: The command accepts a valid work-item ID, rewrites recognized references in the selected work-item record and task files, reports all changed files, and leaves sibling work items unchanged.
Missing, malformed, or unknown work-item IDs return stable non-zero errors without writes.

items.name: migration-scope-contract
items.description: --work-item and --path are mutually exclusive, and every whole-work-item write remains contained by .docs/work-items/<id>/.
items.reason: The migration scope must be explicit and safe.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Combining --path and --work-item is rejected; selected work-item migration does not modify files outside the selected directory.
The response reports deterministic selected scope, changed files, and aggregated replacements.

items.name: minor-release-040
items.description: After all prior WI-0019 tasks pass, bump the package minor version from 0.3.0 to 0.4.0 and verify the compiled launcher reports 0.4.0.
items.reason: The user requests a minor version bump upon completion.

acceptanceCriteria.description: package.json reports 0.4.0, the compiled launcher reports 0.4.0, and release checks pass before the delivery commit.

items.name: master-version-tag
items.description: Create annotated Git tag 0.4.0 on master at the final release commit.
items.reason: The user explicitly requests that the new version be Git tagged on master.

acceptanceCriteria.description: A local master branch points at the final release commit and annotated tag 0.4.0 points to that same commit.

items.name: task-commit-test-gate
items.description: Every WI-0019 implementation, validation, and delivery task must record and pass the complete unit-test command before its task commit.
items.reason: The work-item-wide mutation and release/tag changes cross CLI, filesystem, records, package metadata, and Git state.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Each task result records a passed full test execution and the repository suite is 100% passing at every task commit.
